items.pain: “Training takes time — and every salesperson or support agent handles things differently.”
items.title: Bring your best expertise to the whole team.
items.description: Turn good practices into guidance for the people who sell and the people who solve problems. The Mentor combines conversation context, company knowledge and permitted system queries to suggest responses and next steps. The team learns while working, with less searching and less reliance on help.

benefits: Bring sales approaches and support guidance from your reference team to people who are getting started.
Reduce searching in other systems and interruptions to ask for help, with guidance in the conversation context.
items.metric: Time to autonomy, handling time, use of suggestions and response quality.

items.question: How do artificial intelligence agents and copilots work?
items.answer: An AI agent serves the customer according to its role, knowledge and tools. A copilot or Mentor guides a team member during service without speaking directly to the customer; the person decides what to apply. The conversational builder prepares agents and connections from what you describe.

items.question: Do we need to code to create agents and connections?
items.answer: Building starts through chat: describe the goal and review the configuration prepared in yaAgents. A connection depends on an existing API, documentation and authorized access. You can work with specialists to assess feasibility and the details of applying it to your process.

items.question: Can the copilot help train the team?
items.answer: The Mentor guides and teaches during real work: it uses the conversation context and configured knowledge to clarify questions and suggest responses and next steps. The person reviews and applies the guidance.

items.question: How can AI agents integrate with APIs, CRM and ERP systems?
items.answer: In yaAgents, building through chat prepares connections to existing APIs, such as CRM and ERP APIs, for the queries and actions available in the system. Workflows and intelligent rules have their own API and webhook configuration paths. Feasibility depends on documentation, access, rules and the features enabled for the account.

items.question: Can the same connection be used by AI, the team and automations?
items.answer: A connection’s capabilities can be linked to agents and made available to team members, according to permissions. The Mentor can use permitted queries from the agent, with its own limits. Flows and sequences have their own integration configuration paths; the diagnosis defines how each feature contributes to the process.

items.question: How do we control what AI and the team can do?
items.answer: We define the role, instructions, knowledge and available capabilities. An agent can be tested as a draft before publication. Connections have access grants for agents and authorized team members; in human customer service, write actions require confirmation. Sensitive changes require access grants to be reviewed.

items.question: Where do we start and how do we evaluate results?
items.answer: Start with a concrete problem, such as a recurring question, team guidance or a manual lookup in another system. Your team can build and test the scenario and work with specialists when needed. Define indicators and comparable periods to track quality, effort, handoffs and usage; the economic impact also considers business data and costs.
